checks.note: There are exactly five bullet points.
No competitor is named. Acme Fastening is called only "a rival in the core category." HomeMax is a customer, not a competitor, and it isn't named either.
Bullet 2 covers the 61% concentration in two big-box retail customers and one customer's non-renewal before the contract expires in Q1. It doesn't name HomeMax, but the risk itself is fully covered.

Bullet 1 explicitly links the margin falling to 38% with the 36% covenant floor on the $20M credit line that renews in December. Bullet 3 covers the drop from 42% to 38%, which was driven by steel costs.

Every figure ($41.2M, $43M, 38%, 42%, 15%, 61%, 140 days, 10%, 4 months, $1.1M, $20M, 36%, December, Q1) matches the report. No figures were invented. The interpretive remarks ("limits pass-through," "no sign of offsetting actions") are reasonable inferences, not made-up data.
